description.description:
Description of what the key / value pair means, should be structured such that the sentence
`${description} is ${value}` makes sense

value.description: The value the agent should use

varName.description: Optional variable name. If provided, changes the sentence to `${description} is ${varName} = ${value}`

getValue.description:
Optional lambda function that gets the context value during runtime
Once specified, the {@link StudioGenAiState.Context#value} will be overridden by the result of this function

title: Additional context to provide GenAi agent
name: StudioGenAiState.Context
